thread:
Nina: Quick sync: customers want lower latency in regions we don't run hot. Proposal: per-tenant on-demand region activation that primesteps cache/tokenizers and optionally minimal GPU. Must respect residency.
Omar: Separate planes: control (consent/routing), cache/model (read-only copies), write-sink (single-source until replication).
Jules: Warmup semantics: start in cache-only, then min-slice if requested. Writes during warmup -> buffer with sequence numbers, return 202 + write_id. No sync cross-region commits.
Ravi: Operator runbook: 1) mark eligible 2) dry-run warmup 3) promote route-hint 4) monitor buffer and ship 5) rollback if mismatch. Make steps idempotent.
AuditBot: audit-event:activation:{tenant}:{region}:{ts} stored with cache_sha256 and consent_token.
Nina: Config knobs per-tenant: region_activation_mode(auto/manual), warmup_mode(cache|min-slice|reserved), accept_writes(deny|buffer|readonly), warmup_topk.
Omar: Metrics: warmup_ms, primed_topk, buffer_len, ship_lag_ms, audit_events. Alert on buffer_len > threshold.
Jules: UX: Console state Idle/Warming/Active-local/Active-remote/Quarantined and buffered write gauge.
Ravi: Next: Nina drafts RFC, Jules writes buffer API (202+write_id + replay endpoint), Omar defines alerts, I will draft operator checklist.
Nina: I'll have RFC draft tomorrow EOD.
